title: Correlated Errors as a Function of Model Scale: Replicating on Small Open Models

original_idea.body: Replicate scale-vs-error-correlation within one open family at small sizes.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain but a replication-flavored, somewhat incremental link.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: MCQ benchmark across model sizes, error-agreement stats.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped replication-and-extension with clear error-agreement metric.

novelty.reasoning: Largely a replication of an existing ICML finding at smaller scale.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Mostly a replication of a published correlated-errors result.
